page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the right margin; at the foot, the gathering signature at left and the catchword at right.

main_text.p: ningensium: eadem vero eam si satelles aut minister iussu alterius patret, & ipse & qui iussit, eadem teneantur noxa, idemque supplicium pendant: At si vulnere eundem quis laeserit, poenam vulnerati hominis nobilis duplam solvat. Cetera sunt de obsidibus sex arbitrio Groningensium legendis & in custodia habendis, sicubi contingat foederis huius observationem Leoardiensium vitio claudicare. Signatum celebratumque Leo-ardiae die VI Iduum Octob. EodemqueFœdus a-[?] liud cum multis O- ftergois & We- ftergois. tempore magno numero viri nobiles primarum familiarum, qui hactenus foederi Oftergoo se opposuerant tam Westergoi quam Oftergoi, itemque oppida Franekera & Worcumum, cum cohaerentibus praefecturis, cum audissent Groninganos jam Leoardiam ingressos, Leoardiosque foederis feriundi cum his peravidos esse, ipsi quoque re bene deliberata, dimisso armorum consilio, cum Groninganis pepigere in hunc modum: Nefas esset ipsis, turbare Groningenses, & foedus cum iis jam habentes, aut imposterum habituros: nec contra Groninganis liceret miscere se rebus illorum, aut illos illorum; subditos aut regio-nes

page.notes: The text begins mid-word ("ningensium") and the page ends on a split word ("regio-" / "nes"). The left-hand side of the page is blank. The running head "Vrbe" is printed with v and is normalised to "Urbe". The marginal note's first word is partly unclear: the mark before "liud" may be a superscript "a" or a figure, so "a-" is doubtful. The header figure "137" is printed at the head of the page.
